items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I knew them very well. In fact, I was raised in an Italian neighborhood in Chicago... he and Hal was the two that got mixed up in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. They had some kind of business. Now, I saw a truck pass about two years ago. I don't remember what it was. It had Capone on the truck. Or they strictly legitimate. His brother? Yeah. Was he always? I think so. I never heard anything about him being messed up. Just he and Hal was the two that got mixed up in there. I knew them very well. In fact, I was raised in an Italian neighborhood in Chicago. I'm going to screw with a lot of those fellas. The Anunzios, the Frasciades, Bugles.
Did Acapone come to the cars where you worked? Sure.
